caption:
Battery discharge, month by month. CAISO: the month's battery discharge in CAISO, MWh, summed from the daily cycle table, 1,335,586 MWh in September 2026, up from 1,105,004 MWh in September 2025. The direction holds in 10 of the 12 complete months after September 2025.

Checked five ways before it was drafted: 10 of the 12 complete months after 2025-09 lie above 2025-09's value; from 2025-10 to 2026-09 the change is 139,752, from 2025-09 to 2026-08 it is 357,300; from 2025-10 to 2026-09 the change is 139,752, 60.6 percent of the change from 2025-09; the change is 1.86 typical monthly moves (124,284 MWh a month, the median move between complete months); the floor is 1; 2025-09 holds 30 and 2026-09 holds 30 observations; the floor is 28.

The claim states a change; it does not say what caused it. the two ends of the series are different months of the year; every complete month between them is on the chart.

Source: storage_daily_cycle, as the ERW holds it. ERW table: storage_daily_cycle.
